turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Relay Fiber, this is Jordan. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My internet has been completely down since yesterday morning and I work from home. This is ridiculous.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry, let me check the outage map for your area.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nobody told me anything. Is there an outage in my area or not?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, there's a fiber cut nearby. The estimated restore time is tonight at 9 pm.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's two days without service. I want a credit for this outage.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Outages over 24 hours get an automatic credit on your next bill.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is unacceptable. I want to talk to a supervisor.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Relay Fiber, this is Jordan.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Do you offer a student discount? My son starts college in the fall.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We don't have a student discount, but autopay and paperless billing take five dollars off each month.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. Is there a discount if I set up autopay instead?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, five dollars a month once autopay and paperless are both on. I can set that up now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, let's do that. Thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Relay Fiber, this is Priya.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I'd like to upgrade to the 1 Gig plan.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Happy to help with that.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Does it cost anything to switch plans, and when does it start?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: There's no change fee, and upgrades take effect right away.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect, that's great. Thanks for making it so easy.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Relay Fiber, this is Marco. What can I do for you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Do you have a streaming bundle, like TV channels with the internet?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We only sell internet, so there's no TV or streaming package. I can see if a different plan would save you money.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure. What plans do you have and how much are they?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: There's 300 Meg, 1 Gig, and 2 Gig. Most people are happy on 300 Meg.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, I'll think about it. Thanks anyway.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Relay Fiber, this is Sam.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My speeds are really slow, even on my computer that's plugged in with a cable.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let's run a wired speed test together.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I ran the test with the cable and I'm getting about half my plan speed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That points to the line. I'd like to send a technician.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can a technician come out to look at it? Is there a fee for the visit?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No charge if the problem is our line. The earliest window is Thursday, 10 to 12.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, Thursday morning works. I appreciate the help.
